rack.conflict_body: It arrived when room {room} was already booked {from} → {to}. The booking is still accepted and sits in the "Unassigned" lane. Suggested free rooms: {rooms}.
rack.dep_unconfirmed: Room {room}: guest {guest} checks out today, check-out time not confirmed (reminded at {time}).
rack.hidden_note: Cancelled and no-show bookings aren't shown. Rooms off sale show "Off sale" at the start of the row.
rack.legend_kit: Guest over standard occupancy – prepare extra amenity kit
rack.offline: You're offline. Data as of {time} – reconnecting. Bookings can't be created or changed to avoid double booking.
rooms.below_body: These bookings already have more guests. Change their guest count or move them to another room first.
rooms.capacity_help: Standard: guests included in the price. Maximum: standard + guests sleeping on the sofa. Children under 6 don't count.
rooms.footnote: Nightly list price = monthly price ÷ 12, rounded to 1,000 (BR-101) – calculated by the system. Price changes have an effective date; existing bookings and quotes keep the old price (BR-006).
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.rule_note: Guests over the standard occupancy sleep on the sofa, pay the extra-guest charge (BR-110) and get an extra amenity kit: 1 blanket, 1 bath towel, 1 face towel, toothbrush, toiletries (no pillow).
rooms.snapshot_note: Bookings, quotes and leases created before the effective date keep the old price.
rooms.stop_help: Off = stop selling: the room disappears from the booking form and the rack shows "Off sale". Existing bookings stay.
rooms.subtitle: {rooms} rooms · {groups} groups
rsv.assign_effect: After assigning: the booking leaves the "Unassigned" lane, the red alert clears, and check-in works as normal.
rsv.assign_lead: {channel} sent a {group} booking for {from} → {to} when room {room} was already booked. Pick a free room – suggestions are sorted by fewest orphan nights.
rsv.cancel_rule: Cancelled {days} days ahead: {pct}% of the deposit is refunded (BR-309).
rsv.child_note: Children: only the year of birth – no guest profile, no contact details stored.
rsv.deposit_partial: You can still record the amount received – the booking stays "On hold · awaiting deposit" and shows what's missing.
rsv.extend_rule: Up to +{hours} hours and no later than {time} on the arrival day. Can be extended only once.
rsv.fit_gap: Leaves {n} empty night(s) before the stay
rsv.hold_auto: If no deposit by then, the system cancels the hold and puts the room back on sale.
rsv.kit_task: Housekeeping task: 1 kit (1 blanket, 1 bath towel, 1 face towel, toothbrush, toiletries – no pillow) before {time} · Assigned
rsv.party_missing: {n} guest(s) missing – everyone is needed for the residence registration.
rsv.reason_ota_conflict: OTA booking arrived when the room was full
rsv.reconcile_note: Manually recorded transfers are flagged "awaiting reconciliation" until accounting matches the bank statement.
rsv.upgrade_note: Rooms in another group are suggestions only – the front-desk lead or manager confirms.
sale.commission: Sales earns ({pct}% of room charges – BR-903)
sale.commission_ctv: You earn ({pct}% of room charges – BR-903)
sale.deposit_due: Deposit to hold the room ({pct}% of room charges – BR-305)
sale.hold_next: Send the QR code to the guest. You'll get a reminder {hours} hours before it expires.
sale.hold_until: Expires {time} – without a deposit it's cancelled and the room goes back on sale.
sale.month_note: Monthly stays need a lease – still done outside the app; ask the front desk to hold the room with a manual long-stay booking.
sale.none_body: Try shifting by 1 day: {dates} has 2 rooms.
sale.offline: You're offline – results may be out of date. Quotes can't be made yet.
sale.price_source: Direct rate from today's rate calendar (BR-104). The quote holds the price for {days} days.
sale.qr_after: The QR code uses the booking ID as the transfer note and is created right after the hold.
sale.room_meta: Standard {base} · max {max} (guest {max} sleeps on the sofa)
sale.today_handoff: Sales/agents: ask the front desk to create a paid booking for this guest.
sale.quote_text:
OTTIMO Boutique Stay – Quote {code}
Room {room} {room_name}, {from} → {to} ({nights} nights), {guests}.

Deposit to hold the room: {deposit}. The rest is paid at check-in.
This quote is valid until {expires}.
sale.quote_text_extra_guest: Includes extra-guest charge for {n} guest(s) on the sofa: {amount}.
shell.no_access_body: This page is for another role. If you need it, ask the owner to add the role to your account.
shell.no_access_title: You don't have access to this page
shell.offline_desk: You're offline. Data as of {time} – view only; bookings can't be created or changed.
shell.offline_readonly: You're offline. Data as of {time} – view only; changes can't be saved yet.
shell.subtitle: {property} · {date}
today.dep_unconfirmed: check-out time not confirmed · reminded at {time}
today.empty_body: No arrivals, departures, registrations or holds to handle. Open the room rack to take new bookings.
today.kit_body: {n} guest(s) over standard sleeping on the sofa: 1 blanket, 1 bath towel, 1 face towel, toothbrush and toiletries (no pillow). Task sent to housekeeping.
today.kit_title: Prepare extra amenity kit – room {room}, before {time}
today.money_after_cancel_body: The hold was cancelled automatically before the money arrived. Contact the guest: rebook if a room is free, or refund (manager approval needed).
users.more_help: "More…": Reset password (creates a temporary password), Lock account, Reset 2-step verification.
users.role_desc.collaborator: Sees only their own quotes, bookings and guests; can't confirm deposits.
users.role_desc.front_desk: Bookings, check-in/out, payments, registration on approved devices.
users.role_desc.front_desk_lead: Front desk + approves comps within limits, passes room inspections.
users.role_desc.housekeeping: Cleaning tasks, room inspection, issue reports on the phone.
users.role_desc.maintenance: Work orders, blocking rooms for repair.
users.role_desc.manager: Approves refunds, credit, no-show restores; sees financial reports.
users.role_desc.sales_staff: Quotes, holds, confirming deposits on own bookings.
users.roles_effect: Changes apply when this person signs in again. Their open sessions will be signed out.
users.temp_pw_note: The system creates a temporary password, shown once so you can hand it to the user in person. They must change it at first sign-in.
approval.already_done: This request was already handled by {who} at {time}. The list has been updated.
approval.approve_body: The folio gets a matching negative waiver line with your name. It counts toward your monthly limit.
approval.empty_body: New requests appear here and in notifications.
approval.limit_left: Monthly limit left {left} / {limit} · up to 300,000 per request
approval.offline: Offline since {time}. The list may be out of date – approving needs a connection.
approval.over_your_limit: Above your {limit} per-request limit – a manager approves.
approval.reject_effect: The waiver line is dropped; the charge stays on the folio.
checkin.cond.document_ok: Foreign guest documents valid on arrival date
checkin.kit_not_ready: The extra amenity kit for room {room} isn't ready yet. You can still check in – the task has been moved to the top of the housekeeping queue.
checkin.prior_night: Guest arriving before 06:00 – add the night of {date}: {amount}. This is room revenue, not a surcharge.
checkin.prior_night_unavailable: Room {room} is occupied on the night of {date}. Offer luggage storage or move to an available room.
ci.ask_foc_help: Pick a reason. The request goes automatically to people allowed to approve – you don't choose an approver. The folio shows the surcharge and a "pending" waiver line.
ci.block_body: {doc} expired on {date}, before the arrival date {arrival}. No check-in (and no code or key card) until a senior receptionist or above approves.
ci.block_entry: No entry stamp / entry record. No check-in until a senior receptionist or above approves.
ci.block_fd: You (receptionist): send to a senior receptionist to confirm. The manager is notified.
ci.block_lead_body: Senior receptionist, manager or owner only. Enter the reason and how it was handled; the manager is notified. After confirming, the Check in button unlocks.
ci.child_doc: Child · personal ID number ending {last4} · no photo needed
ci.cond_balance: {amount} still due – collect in step 4, before handing over the door code.
ci.cond_doc: Start with the main guest in step 1. Other guests can be added before the registration deadline.
ci.cond_na_citizen: Not applicable – everyone on the booking is a Vietnamese citizen.
ci.deadline_citizen_late: Guests arriving from 23:00 → due 08:00 the next morning.
ci.doc_blocked_body: A foreign guest's document had expired on the arrival date, or there's no entry stamp. A senior receptionist or above confirms check-in (with reason and handling); the manager is notified.
ci.door_done: Code created in the lock app and given to the guest
ci.door_not_stored: OTTIMO doesn't store door codes in R2. On check-out or room change, the system creates a "Delete code in lock app" task.
ci.door_step1: Open the TTLock app and create a random 6-digit code for room {room} with exactly the validity above.
ci.door_step2: Read the code to the guest or hand over key cards (max 2). Don't message the code together with the room number or address.
ci.door_step3: Guest wants a birthday code: ddmm + 3 random digits (7 digits), never the plain birthday.
ci.door_title: Door code – entered manually in the lock app (R2)
ci.effect_fee: Early check-in surcharge of {amount} goes on the folio (guest informed).
ci.effect_status: Booking becomes "In house", room {room} becomes "Occupied, clean".
ci.empty_body: Today's arrivals are checked in or handled as no-shows. Walk-in guest: create a booking, then check in.
ci.extra_night_help: Check the room is free the night before. OTA booking: create a linked Direct booking for that night; if the room is taken, offer luggage storage or another room.
ci.manual_note: Passport: add passport expiry, visa and entry date so the system can check them. If left empty the result is "Not checked yet".
ci.name_match_note: Booking "{booking}" · document "{doc}" – match (accents ignored, order swapped).
ci.no_block_note: Expires during the stay: check-in isn't blocked; the door code is still handed over.
ci.offline: Offline since {time}. Check-in, IDs and payments need a connection – nothing is stored on this device. If the guest is waiting, use the backup sheet and enter it later.
ci.offline_short: Waiting for a connection to continue.
ci.ooo_never: A room that is out of order (OOO) can never be checked in to.
ci.party_later: {n} guests still have no ID. You can check in once the main guest's ID is in; add the others before the registration deadline {deadline}.
ci.pay_ota_prepaid: Booking.com has collected the room charge – only the early check-in surcharge is due. Direct/agent bookings (e.g. 302: 3,344,000 VND) must be paid in full here.
ci.pay_title: Collect payment before handing over the code
ci.recon_ok: Manually recorded transfers are flagged "Awaiting reconciliation" but count as paid – check-in can go ahead.
ci.stepup_body: Viewing full ID numbers and photos is recorded in the access log. Re-enter your password – valid for 15 minutes on this device.
ci.time_default: Surcharge is based on the standard time {std} – currently 0 VND.
ci.time_default_help: The actual check-in time is recorded when you tap "Check in". If the guest arrives early, turn on "Guest checks in early" above.
ci.told_guest: I've told the guest about this surcharge
ci.undo_body: The booking returns to "Confirmed" and the room to its previous status. A "Delete code in lock app" task is created. Only possible on the same day and if no new folio lines exist.
ci.untrusted_note: The IDs, checks and registration steps are hidden. Conditions and folio stay visible; check-in must be done on an approved desk computer.
ci.visa_attention: The booking goes to "Needs attention"; the proposed registered departure date = visa expiry date.
co.debt_mgr: Managers/owners also see "Record as debt" – due date and reason required.
co.done_tasks: Folio {bill}. Tasks created: clean room, refill minibar, delete code in lock app.
co.effect_bill: The server issues the folio number; after this the folio can't be edited (managers can post adjustments).
co.effect_door: A "Delete code in lock app" task is created for room {room} (R2 manual).
co.effect_kit_note: Bookings with a guest on the sofa also get an extra-kit pickup task.
co.effect_status: Booking becomes "Checked out", room becomes "Vacant, dirty"; cleaning and minibar refill tasks are created.
co.foc_pending: Waiver of {amount} is awaiting approval. Check-out can't be completed until it's decided – or withdraw it and collect in full.
co.house_rules_not_sent: House rules not recorded as sent – think twice before charging a fine
co.invoice_r3: E-invoices are issued from Round 3; R2 stores the details for accounting.
co.late_switch_hint: Guest leaving after 12:00 without an agreed time: use "Late check-out" in the booking details to calculate and tell them first.
co.minibar_not_checked: Minibar not checked. Do step 1 before completing.
co.minibar_skip: Skip this step – go to Charges.
co.offline: Offline since {time}. Payments and check-out can't be completed without a connection – ask the guest to wait, or note it on paper and enter it later.
co.partial_hint: Record what was received, then choose another method for the rest.
co.pos_code: Approval code on the POS slip
co.pos_no_card: Never enter the card number – only the approval code printed on the POS slip.
co.recon_explain: "Awaiting reconciliation" still counts as paid. If the manager can't find the money, the folio goes back to balance due and the manager is notified.
co.recon_missing_effect: "Money not received": the payment is marked disputed, the folio goes back to balance due, and the manager is notified.
co.tax_code_err: The tax code has 10 or 13 digits (hyphens allowed).
co.time_from_late: From the agreed late check-out time {time}.
error.SELF_RECONCILE_FORBIDDEN: A payment you recorded must be reconciled by someone else.
field_error.doc_number: ID number format isn't right (citizen/personal ID: 12 digits).
field_error.evidence_required: Add a photo or a note as evidence for this fine/damage charge.
field_error.minibar_over_standard: No more than {max} (the minibar's standard stock).
foc.over_self_limit: Waiving {amount} would exceed your self-waiver limit of {limit}/month. The request goes to a senior receptionist.
foc.r_room_ready: Room ready, no impact on next guest
foc.route_note: No need to choose an approver: the request goes to everyone allowed to approve this amount ({roles}). The first to respond decides.
foc.self_apply: Minibar {amount} is within your self-waiver limit ({used}/{limit} used this month). Re-enter your password to apply it now.
foc.self_apply_note: The line is marked "self-applied within limit", included in the FOC report and reviewed by the senior receptionist.
foc.title: Waiver · {line} · {amount}
guest.oci.companions_at_desk: Other guests answer this question themselves at reception.
guest.oci.withdraw_hint: Want to withdraw consent to keep photos? Tell reception – the photos will be deleted.
gw.cap_consent: 3 · Consent Yes/No – Send unlocks once chosen
gw.cap_docs: 1 · IDs per guest (switch state to see uploading / error / offline)
gw.cap_done: Done – the R2 version doesn't promise a door code on the page
gw.cap_home: Stay page – 3 tabs, no Bill tab in R2.
gw.closed_body: You don't need to send anything else. Need help? Message or call reception.
gw.docs_none: No IDs yet – start with Guest 1 ({m} guests on the booking).
gw.done_desk_check: At reception, staff will take a few minutes to check your original documents.
gw.door_at_desk: Reception gives you your door code when you arrive. Arriving after 22:00? Call the night staff when you get here.
gw.ended_body: Your stay has ended. Need your folio or help? Message OTTIMO on Zalo/WhatsApp.
gw.late_r2: Arriving after 22:00: the night staff will check you in and give you the door code when you arrive – call the number on this page when you get here.
gw.link_reissue_title: Issue a new link for booking {code}? The old link stops working immediately.
gw.link_revoke_title: Revoke the link for booking {code}? Guests opening it will see "Link expired".
gw.notice_body: OTTIMO uses your ID details to register your stay with the police, as required by Vietnamese law. ID photos are encrypted; only reception and managers can see them. You'll be asked separately whether we may keep the photos after registration.
gw.offline_upload: You're offline – unsent photos aren't kept on this device. When you're back online, take them again to send.
gw.photo_tips: Place the ID on a dark surface in good light, all 4 corners visible, no glare.
gw.prechecked_notice: Guest {code} checked in online – arriving at {eta}
gw.saved_progress: Progress saved – open the link again to continue.
gw.sent_hidden: Sent – for your safety, the photo isn't shown again here.
gw.take_photo_again: Retake with the Take photo button
gw.wifi_later: Shown here on your arrival day ({date}).
late.grace_off: A guest is arriving in this room today – the 12:30 grace period doesn't apply.
mlog.empty_body: Change the date range or clear the person filter.
mlog.empty_title: No money actions in this period
reg2.all_note: All records from the last 30 days, filter by status.
reg2.citizen_note: Fields follow the residence notice form: full name, date of birth, ID number, arrival/departure dates. Address only if the portal asks.
reg2.code_help: Paste the exact code the portal returns after submitting.
reg2.consent_granted_app: Agreed to keep photos · via app
reg2.consent_q: Does the guest agree to OTTIMO keeping ID photos for {days} days after check-out?
reg2.copy_help: Data appears only after re-entering your password, and every view is logged. Tap "Copy" for each field in order and paste into the portal.
reg2.edit_after_sent: Already registered on the portal – editing here doesn't change the portal.
reg2.empty_body: Every in-house guest is registered. New records appear when guests check in or send IDs via the app.
reg2.offline: Offline. List as of {time} – deadlines only. IDs can't be opened and registration data can't be copied without a connection.
reg2.reject_effect: The record returns to "IDs complete · awaiting registration" to fix and resubmit.
reg2.retention_refused_value: Deleted as soon as the portal confirms
reg2.sent_note: Portal reference {code} · sent at {time}. Photos of guests who declined are deleted automatically when the portal confirms.
reg2.upd_empty_body: When a foreign guest extends, leaves early or checks out, their record appears here so the departure date can be updated on the portal the same day.
reg2.withdraw_body: The guest withdrew consent at reception. The portal has already confirmed the registration, so the ID photos are deleted now; the registered details are kept as required by law.
reg2.withdraw_title: Record that {guest} doesn't agree to keep photos?
stay.after_noon_hint: Times after 12:00 are late check-outs – use Late check-out to calculate the fee.
stay.arrival_toggle: Guest arriving in this room today (demo)
stay.card_overdue_when: Flagged at {time} – no arrival in this room, so after the grace period.
stay.change_effect_door: Task "Delete code in lock app" for room {old} and create a new code for room {new}.
stay.change_effect_old: Room {room} needs cleaning and gets a cleaning task.
stay.change_effect_reg: Registration doesn't need redoing – only the room number in the record changes.
stay.charge_default: Default price {amount} per {rule}. Fines don't count as room revenue.
stay.door_manual: Handed over via the lock app – not stored in OTTIMO (R2)
stay.extend_door: Remember to extend the door code's validity in the lock app to the new check-out time.
stay.grace_rule: The grace period to 12:30 applies only when no guest arrives in the room the same day; the 15:00 and 18:00 cut-offs don't move.
stay.late_door_manual: R2: extend the code's validity in the lock app manually.
stay.late_to_extend: Leaving after 18:00 means one more night – use Extend so the night is closed on all channels.
stay.long_hint: Guest wants more than 7 extra nights or 28+ nights in total: long-stay quote (R3). In R2 create a "manual long-stay booking".
stay.no_charges_body: The folio only has room charges. Add charges when the guest uses services or incurs a fine.
stay.see_full: See the full version in the section below
stay.visa_dialog: {guest}'s visa expires on {date}, before departure {departure}. Registration only runs to {date}. Remind the guest to extend before {remind}.
stay.visa_warn: The guest's visa expires on {date}. Registration only runs to {date}; enter a reason to continue and remind the guest to extend their visa.
sur.early_extra_night: Check-in before 06:00 = selling an extra night on {date} (not a surcharge). The system checks the room is free that night.
sur.early_fee: Suggested early check-in surcharge: {amount} ({pct}% of first night)
field_error.name_invalid: Names may contain letters, spaces and hyphens only.
field_error.phone_country: Foreign numbers start with + and the country code, e.g. +7 912 345 6789.
field_error.email_invalid: Check the email format, e.g. name@gmail.com.

field_error.not_in_list: Choose a value from the list.
field_error.contact_required: Add at least a phone number or an email.
field_error.contact_channel_empty: Enter {channel} before choosing it as preferred contact.
field_error.checklist_required: Complete the checklist before granting access.
field_error.possible_duplicate_other: This phone/email already has a profile. Ask the front desk to check before creating one.
auth.mfa_later: Two-step sign-in comes in a later release. Ask the owner for help signing in.
shell.coming_body: {screen} comes in a later trial build. Other screens work as usual.
rooms.view_only: You are viewing the unit list. Only the owner and managers can edit.

crm.prompt_body: Type at least 2 characters of the name, guest code or phone/email.
crm.note_hint: Do not write ID numbers, card numbers or health information.
users.roles_confirm_body: They will be signed out on every device right away.
users.reset_pw_body: They are signed out everywhere and must change the temporary password at next sign-in.
users.temp_pw_once: Shown only once. Hand it over in person; don't send it by chat.
users.lock_body: They are signed out on every device and cannot sign in until unlocked.
device.empty: No device has been granted access yet.

params.k.foc_self_apply_front_desk_per_m: Front desk complimentary limit – per month

common.error_network_body: Couldn't reach the server. Check the connection, then tap Try again. Nothing has been lost.
hk.offline_bar: You're offline. You can keep tapping – changes send by themselves when you're back online.
hk.empty_body: No more tasks today. New ones will appear here.
hk.error_body: The connection may be weak. Nothing you tapped is lost. Tap Try again; if it still fails, call the front desk.
hk.kit.collect_how: Send the blanket and towels to the laundry; throw away opened toothbrush and toiletries.
hk.kit.collect_reason: The booking now has fewer guests
hk.kit.transfer: Move {n} extra-guest kit(s) from room {from} to room {to}
hk.kit.not_ready_body: The front desk can still check the guest in but will see a warning. This task is now at the top of your list.
hk.step.kitchen: Wipe the kitchen, empty bins, check the fridge
hk.finish_help_vacant: Tap Finished cleaning when everything is done. The room becomes "Cleaned – awaiting inspection" and the front desk lead is asked to inspect.
hk.finish_help_occupied: Tap Finished cleaning when everything is done. The room becomes "Guest staying – cleaned".
hk.report_this_room: Report a problem in this room
hk.room_no_task_title: No tasks for this room today
hk.room_no_task_body: New tasks from the front desk will appear here.
hk.err.transition_title: Room {room} was just changed by someone else
hk.err.invalid_transition: Room {room} is now "{status}", so it can't be marked Finished cleaning. No need to redo anything – check your task list.
hk.queued_toast: Saved on this phone – it will send when you're back online
hk.done_wait_inspect_note: Cleaned at {time} · front desk lead asked to inspect
hk.insp.title: Inspect room {room}
hk.insp.legend: Tick each item that meets the OTTIMO standard
hk.insp.i05: Kitchen clean, bottled water in the fridge
hk.insp.fail_note: What didn't pass? Write it down so it can be fixed
hk.insp.fail_effect: The room goes back to "Needs cleaning (guest left)" with a re-clean task.
hk.insp.empty_body: A manager needs to set up the checklist first. Let the front desk lead know.
hk.insp.self_off_title: You can't self-inspect this room yet
hk.insp.self_off_body: Self-inspection isn't switched on for this property. The front desk lead will inspect – nothing more for you to do.
hk.minibar_help: Count what's left. The system works out what was used and what to restock.
hk.refuse_effect: Today's cleaning for this room is skipped. The front desk sees the reason. Cleaning resumes tomorrow as usual.
hk.wo.offline: You're offline – you can still send. The report and photos stay on this phone and send when you're back online; the work-order number comes after.
hk.wo.desc_required: Add a few words so maintenance knows what to bring.
hk.wo.block_request: Suggest blocking the room – no sales until fixed
hk.wo.pick_room_body: Open this from a task card or pick a room above to report a problem.
hk.wo.sent_body_high: Maintenance, front desk and the manager have been notified. Maintenance will pick it up within 15 minutes.
hk.wo.sent_body: Maintenance can see it now. Nothing more for you to do.
hk.wo.queued_title: Saved on this phone – not sent yet
hk.wo.queued_body: It will send when you're back online. Urgent? Call the front desk now – don't wait.
hk.queue.rejected_body: When you tapped ({time}), the room was already "{status}". No need to redo it.
hk.queue.keep_note: Don't clear browser data or remove the app while changes are waiting to send.
hk.queue.empty_body: No changes waiting on this phone.
hk.queue.retry_title: Not sent yet – will try again
hk.queue.retry_body: The server didn't receive it. Your changes are still on this phone; next try at {time}.
hk.queue.relogin_title: Sign in again to keep sending
hk.queue.relogin_body: {n} changes are still on this phone and will send after you sign in.
hk.queue.task_cancelled: Room {room} – this task was cancelled because the booking changed
hk.queue.task_cancelled_body: Nothing to do. Check your updated task list.
wo.sev.high_help: Safety, or a staying guest is affected: no hot water, no power, broken lock, leak
wo.due.plan: Have a solution by {time} (fixed, or the guest moved to another room).
wo.source.guest_app: Reported by guest in the app
wo.empty_body: New work orders from housekeeping, the front desk or guests will show here with a notification.

co.late_switch_hint_time: Guest wants to leave after {time}? Use "Late check-out" in the booking details to work it out and tell them first.
dep.qr_failed: Couldn't create the VietQR code – the booking isn't affected. Select Try again.
dep.qr_pending: A deposit VietQR for {amount} is waiting for the guest's transfer (valid until {time}). When the money reaches OTTIMO's account, select Confirm deposit received.

move.preview_failed: Couldn't check the price, so the change can't be saved yet. Select Try again.

move.basis.keep_booked_rate: Each night keeps its booked rate (BR-429).
move.basis.external_contract: Priced by the paper contract – moving doesn't change the amount.
move.basis.ota: OTA booking: the OTA price stays; the guest pays the difference against the booked room at the desk (BR-424).
move.ota_difference: Room change difference (paid at the desk)
move.pending_foc: Complimentary (FOC) awaiting approval: if approved, a further {amount} comes off (not included above)
move.deposit_paid: Deposit paid (kept as is, no top-up)

move.delta_changed: The amount just changed to {amount} (rates or the booking were updated). Check the new figures, tell the guest again and tick again.
move.warn.MANUAL_RATE_REPRICED: Some nights had a manual or agreed rate – they now use the new room's rate. To keep the deal, edit the night rate after saving.
ci.due_prior_night: Added night – room charge (posted at check-in)
ci.pay_inline: The {amount} payment is recorded together with the check-in – if the check-in fails, nothing is recorded.
ci.pay_qr_first: VietQR: create the code, wait for the money, then select Record payment before checking in.
ci.submit_needs_pay: Collect {amount} under Payment before checking in.
svc.title: Services on the booking

svc.load_failed: Couldn't load the booking's service lines, so the no-show can't be marked yet. Select Try again.
cancel.refund_request: A refund request of {amount} will be created – it needs manager approval.
co.debt_toggle: Record as debt – guest pays later

co.debt_due_past: Choose a due date from today onwards.

co.debt_effect: Records a debt of {amount}, due {date} – the reason goes into the money log.
rsv.receipt_help: A screenshot of the transfer or the receipt (JPG, PNG, WebP, up to 10 MB). Optional but recommended – the front desk uses it to check the bank statement.
rsv.receipt_upload_failed: Couldn't upload the receipt, so the deposit hasn't been reported yet. The amount and photo are still here – select Report deposit sent to try again.
today.kpi_unassigned: + {n} OTA booking(s) without a room (not counted)

attn.ooo_ending_work_open: Room {room} goes back on sale {date} but work order {code} isn't done

attn.ota_no_show_revoke: Ask {channel} to cancel the no-show – booking {code}

hk.queue.checklist_outdated: The inspection checklist has just changed. Open room {room} again and inspect it again.
hk.queue.rejected_other: The server didn't accept this change (code {code}). Tell the front desk if the room still needs updating.
hk.photo_error: This photo can't be used – take it again.

guest.req.decline.duplicate: Same as a request you've already sent

party.slot_required: Choose this guest's ID slot or "None" to enable Remove from booking.

bk.use_room_check: Switching to room {room} – check the price before creating the booking
folio.adjust_night_price: New night rate (before the length-of-stay discount)

folio.adjust_void: Cancel the whole line (a reversal entry – nothing is deleted)

folio.settled_fd: The folio is settled – ask a manager to record any adjustment.
pay.reverse_body: Nothing is deleted: a reversal of the same amount is recorded with your reason and name. The balance due goes back up by {amount}.
pay.reverse_invalid: This payment was already reversed or is no longer recorded as received. Close this box to see the latest list.
approval.changed_since_open: This request was changed after you opened it (amount or payout details). Reload to see the latest version, then decide.
hk.desk.cancel_effect: The task leaves the housekeeping list. If it's needed later, create a new task.
hk.desk.type.extra_guest_kit_transfer: Move the extra amenity kit to this room
wo.col.title: Issue

wo.block_conflict_dates: Move these bookings to another room first (reason "Room fault"), then block again.

ooo.release_needs_wo: This block belongs to {code} – close the work order to release it.
ooo.cancel_effect: The room is no longer blocked for {from} – {to} and stays on sale.
ooo.saved: Block saved for room {room}: back on sale from {date}.
ooo.empty: No room blocks in the last 30 days or the next 4 months.
ooo.mgr_only: Only a manager can release a block that has no work order.

mb.price_note: The new price applies to later minibar checks. Lines already on a folio keep their price.
mb.readonly: Only managers and the owner can edit items and prices.
mb.empty_body: Add items to check the minibar at check-out.

ci.submit_pay_amount_needed: Enter the amount received to check in.

rate.night_now: This night is now {amount} after the length-of-stay discount (calendar rate {calendar}).

co.late_fee_foc: Waive or reduce this fee (applied when the manager confirms)

co.late_fee_locked: Confirmation is locked for now after several failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.

pay.qr_pending_earlier: A VietQR made earlier is still waiting: {amount}, expires {time}. Check the bank app, then confirm receipt.

co.minibar_period_changed_body: The minibar was refilled or the stay changed during the count, so the figures entered were not saved. Count the minibar again, then save.
